blocks.title: Who is Who?
blocks.body: Saying 'Rahul' again and again is boring. 'Rahul has a dog. Rahul likes the dog.' Let's fix this!

blocks.question: What word can replace a boy's name?

blocks.back: A word used instead of a Noun (He, She, It, They).

blocks.title: Using Pronouns
blocks.body:
Boy/Man -> He
Girl/Woman -> She
Animal/Thing -> It
Many people -> They

blocks.question: Which pronoun replaces 'My mother'?
blocks.explanation: Mother is a woman, so we use 'She'.

blocks.title: Better Sentences
blocks.body: Instead of 'Rahul has a dog. Rahul likes the dog.' we say 'Rahul has a dog. He likes it.' Much better!

blocks.question: Find the pronoun: 'It is a big car.'
blocks.explanation: 'It' is a pronoun used for the car.
